reviews.text: Society Pet Sitter have cared for our cats for years. They are consistent, caring & attentive. They are also flexible! We've changed plans, modified our instructions or added days at the last minute, & they are accommodating every time. We highly recommend this company to care for your furry loved ones!

Well, this makes me sad, after over 10 years of working with them to provide pet sitting services to our babies, this year has been a tough one. They sat for us in the spring and I just tried to book for fall and they sent an email that they didn't have coverage available, not even trying to find us a sitter. In spring they had trouble covering overnights for my cats and I got the assumption they felt like overnighting for cats was just not something they want to do. When we had our dog Han Solo (he has passed) there was never any trouble. We always had a consistent pet sitter. But then this year, there were three different ones and even a fourth that no showed a meet and greet. Then after I booked for fall a couple of days ago, and they accepted the bookings, they suddenly said 'we don't have coverage' and sent me off to find a new sitter. They did recommend someone which was great. I have referred them over the years to many people and now I'm not able to do that. Bittersweet, that's for sure.

If you’re looking for a sitter to walk your dog while at work or even out of town, we do overnights from putting any pet tax. Anything you need for your fur babies? Please reach out to us through our website.
have used for many years.  very reliable and really kind to my Louie ( and he's a pill)

I am beyond thrilled with the care our furry friends received from Mark, Misty, and Victoria.  They arrived when promised and took excellent care of Jim, Nick and Nora. When we came home, no one was mad at us for leaving which says a lot! Thank you for providing such reliable and compassionate care for our family members that cannot travel with us.

We've used Society Pet Sitters for several years to spend the nights and take care of our cats when we travel. Their sitters are amazing. They are so friendly and loving to the animals. We are grateful for their constant updates and photos. The  office staff is top-notch as well. Thank you, Society Pet Sitters, for looking after the house and our fur-babies!

I’ve been using Society Pet sitter for in home pet sitting for a couple years and I’ve consistently had quick communication and frequent updates from all the sitters I’ve worked with. They’ve even helped multiple times with last minute adds or when we’ve had flight delays.
I’ve had the best experience with them. They really get to know your pets and make sure they’re always comfortable 💕
Used the service three times now and am very pleased.  Worked with Kim and Josh and both were great.  Highly recommended.
Great customer service and will do their best to work with your schedule! Love their flexibility!

We started using Society Pet Sitter late last year and we love them.  The team responds quickly and the registration is simple and easy.  Our pet sitter, Josh, is just a joy to work with.  He is very responsible and treats our house and pets with respect.  He goes above and beyond to ensure our pets are comfortable and well cared for.  We highly recommend them.

I have used Society Pet Sitter for in home visits. Tiffany Watson is so organized and does such a good job of communicating with the client and her sitters. The staff quickly responds to requests for visits and overnight stays. They notify you in advance to schedule reservations for holidays.

The sitters do such a great job and I appreciate all of the pictures from each visit. My dog is always very calm when we get home and I can tell she was well taken care of. My favorite sitters are Britney and Karen.
Hired Society Pet Sitter for daily walks for my dog. Great communication, walkers are reliable, reasonably-priced, and trustworthy. Would highly recommend!
